newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian stocks (inventories) rise in Q3.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian stocks (inventories) rise in Q3.

text.p: The value of stocks held by Australian private businesses rose an estimated 2.3 percent, seasonally-adjusted, to A$62.04 billion in the September quarter from the June quarter, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
The June quarter value of stocks rose a revised 1.4 percent to A$60.64 billion.
It also said sales by manufacturers rose an estimated 2.4 percent in the September quarter from the June quarter. Both figures are at constant 1989/90 prices.

The bureau said the second estimate for manufacturers' expected (current price) sales for 1996/97 ending June 30 was A$189.51 billion compared to a first estimate of A$182.81 billion.
The change in September quarter stocks implied a contribution to gross domestic product growth in the quarter of around 0.5 percentage point.
